headline: Mooring and Marban Flare as Expanse Battle Endures
war_summary: Three hours later the wires tell of fresh movement in Mooring County and Marban Hollow while the Weathered Expanse endures. Mooring County quickens to five changes in two hours and 49 in the day, with MacConmara Barrows, the Cut and Gravekeeper's Holdfast busiest, now counted at ten Warden to two Colonial bases and day losses of 7,876 Colonial and 8,466 Warden with both casualty rates accelerating. Marban Hollow stirs anew with five changes in two hours and 18 in the day about Checkpoint Bua, listed at one Warden, five Colonial and two neutral. The Expanse holds at three changes in two hours and 71 in the day, down from 83, now five Warden, one Colonial and three neutral about Wightwalk and Frostmarch, with day losses of 9,027 Colonial and 12,012 Warden still accelerating. Linn Mercy breaks the quiet with a late flip at Lathair amid sharply quickening losses of 1,736 and 4,096. Stlican Shelf, Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line, Gutter, Olavis Wake, Palantine Berm, Pari Peak and Godcrofts record nothing in six hours, though the Nevish Line still shows 4,651 and 4,368 lost, with Stonecradle and the Deadlands likewise bloody but flip-less.
